svg.title: LogicFly: real-world multi-room execution and conditional search
svg.desc: Measured structural map with recorded onboard EKF flight trajectory, four third-person photographs, and a three-step laptop recovery sequence.
svg.text: Check the laptop, toolbox, microwave, and cup. If the laptop is absent, find it.
A: laptop absent at expected location
(c) Conditional search: inspect the expected location, then search another room
